bearerAuth.description: An Auth0 access token for this API. A user's token writes loo data directly unless the user is blocked in Auth0. A machine-to-machine (client-credentials) token writes directly only when it carries `access:admin`; otherwise its changes are queued for moderation.

cookieAuth.name: access_token
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie issued via `/admin/login`. Contains a JWT tied to the user session and falls back to `id_token` when `access_token` is absent.

Coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates (WGS84). In writes, lat must be within -90..90 and lng within -180..180; a non-admin's new or changed location must also be inside the box lat 48.9..61.0, lng -8.7..1.9 (Great Britain, Northern Ireland, the Isle of Man and the Channel Islands), or the write fails with 400 `location_out_of_area`.

anyOf.description: A day with opening hours: [open, close] in HH:mm format
A closed day represented as an empty array

OpeningTimes.description: Opening times for each day of the week. Array has 7 elements: Monday (0) through Sunday (6). Each element is either ["HH:mm", "HH:mm"] for open days, or [] for closed days. If all opening times are unknown, the entire field is null.

AdminArea.description: Administrative subdivision associated with a loo.

email.description: Optional reply address. Empty means none. Never logged or sent to Slack.

route.description: Page path or app version the message was sent from. Longer values are truncated.

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token; required only when the server enables Turnstile.

contributor.description: Contributor identifier. Null unless the caller provides an Auth0 admin token.

diff.description: Field-level changes introduced by the report.

LooMutation.description: Attributes accepted when creating or updating a loo.

active.description: Admins only (anyone else gets 400 `admin_only_fields`; use `/report` and `/restore`). Whether the loo is shown on the map. Must be true or false; null is rejected.

openingTimes.description: Opening times for each day of the week. Array has 7 elements: Monday (0) through Sunday (6). Each element is either ["HH:mm", "HH:mm"] for open days, or [] for closed days. If all opening times are unknown, the entire field is null.

location.description: Optional location update. Null clears an existing location (admins only; anyone else gets 400 `location_required`). A non-admin move of more than 50 m is queued (202, `reason: large_move`).

id.description: Admins only; anyone else gets 400 `id_not_allowed` (omit it and an id is generated). Upper case is accepted and lowercased.

allOf.description: Omitted fields are left unchanged; null clears a field. Fields equal to the stored value are ignored.

baseUpdatedAt.description: The `updatedAt` of the record the client loaded. If the record has changed since, the request fails with 409 and the current record.

message.example: This toilet was changed by someone else while you were editing.

reason.description: permanently_closed, does_not_exist (or in the wrong place), not_public, duplicate, or other.

details.description: Free text, stored as `removalReason`. Required for `other`; otherwise a default sentence for the reason is stored.

duplicateOf.description: Required for `duplicate` (and only allowed there): an active loo other than this one.

baseUpdatedAt.description: The `updatedAt` the client loaded. A mismatch returns 409 `conflict`.

details.description: Optional note for the moderator. Kept on queued restores only; a direct (trusted) restore does not store it and answers with `detailsIgnored: true`.

baseUpdatedAt.description: The `updatedAt` the client loaded. A mismatch returns 409 `conflict`.

unchanged.description: True when the submission matched the current record and nothing was queued.

reason.description: Why a write from a caller who could otherwise write directly was queued: `large_move` when a non-admin moves a loo more than 50 m; `daily_cap` when the account has already made its daily allowance of removals and moves (default 10 in any 24 hours; admins exempt); `queue_mode` while the write kill switch queues every non-admin write.

area.description: Administrative areas linked to the loo.

removalCategory.description: Why the loo was removed from the map. Null while it is active.

duplicateOf.description: For a removed duplicate, the id of the loo it duplicates.

openingTimes.description: Opening hours for each day of the week, or null if completely unknown.

reports.description: Recent reports are populated on specific endpoints.

contributorsCount.description: Number of contributors recorded for the loo.

distance.description: Distance from the requested point in meters.

active.description: False for removed loos, which are only returned with `includeInactive=true`.

contributor.description: Contributor identifier. Null unless the caller provides an Auth0 admin token.

diff.description: Field-level changes introduced by the report.

removalCategory.description: Why the loo was removed from the map. Null while it is active.

duplicateOf.description: For a removed duplicate, the id of the loo it duplicates.

recentWindowDays.description: Number of days considered when computing recent updates.

recent.description: Records updated within the recentWindowDays timeframe.

areas.description: Top areas by record count for the current filters.

data.description: Summary report entries. Pass hydrate=true to receive full Report objects. Contributor fields are null unless the caller includes an Auth0 admin token.

cursor.description: Server sync cursor: the database clock minus 120 seconds, read before the data was queried. Pass it back unchanged as `since` to `/api/loos/updates`; never substitute the client clock. The overlap means a row can be delivered twice, so apply updates idempotently.

Server sync cursor: the database clock minus 120 seconds, read before the data was queried. Pass it back unchanged as `since` to `/api/loos/updates`; never substitute the client clock. The overlap means a row can be delivered twice, so apply updates idempotently.

compressed.description: The loo's map tuple, exactly as `/api/loos/dump` will serve it, so clients can patch a cached map immediately. `null` when the loo is not on the map (inactive or without a location).

detailsIgnored.description: Present when the request carried `details`. Direct restores do not store the note; only queued restores keep it for the moderator.

upserted.description: Loos on the map that were created or updated after `since`.

deleted.description: IDs of loos that left the map (deactivated or without a location) after `since`.

post.summary: Send feedback to the Toilet Map team
post.description: Public and unauthenticated. Accepts JSON or a URL-encoded form with the same fields (the legacy website and the Flutter app use these shapes). `email` is optional; an empty string means none. Unknown fields are ignored. Stored for the team; an excerpt of the text and the `route` (never the email or IP) may be posted to Slack. Rate limited per IP. When the server has a Turnstile secret configured, `turnstileToken` (or `cf-turnstile-response`) is required.

200.description: Stored. (200, not 201, for compatibility with the Flutter app.)

400.description: Missing or too-long text, an invalid email address, or a malformed body.

403.description: Turnstile is enabled and the token is missing or invalid.

503.description: Turnstile is enabled but could not be reached.

get.summary: Search for a place or postcode in Great Britain
get.description: Public and unauthenticated; rate limited with the other reads, and explicit searches also per IP (20 a minute). Anything shaped like a UK postcode or outcode is looked up on postcodes.io first; everything else (and unknown postcodes) is searched on OpenStreetMap's Nominatim, limited to Great Britain. `mode=suggest` is for search-as-you-type: it only looks postcodes and outcodes up and never asks Nominatim, whose usage policy forbids autocomplete. Results are cached for 24 hours, keyed on the mode and the normalised query. Nominatim results carry OpenStreetMap's attribution, which must be shown with them.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The place, address or postcode. Whitespace is collapsed and case ignored.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `search` (the default: an explicit search, which may use Nominatim) or `suggest` (typing: postcodes and outcodes only, an empty list for anything else).

200.description: Up to five results, best first. An empty list means nothing matched.

bbox.description: The result's extent as [west, south, east, north].

attribution.description: Attribution to show with the results, or null when none is needed.

400.description: Missing, too short or too long `q`, or an unknown `mode`.

429.description: Too many requests (the read limit, or the per-IP limit on explicit searches).

502.description: The upstream geocoder failed or timed out.

503.description: Place search is busy (Nominatim's one request a second is used up); retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

200.description: Areas available for association with loos.

get.description: Compatibility endpoint for clients of the old www.toiletmap.org.uk/api GraphQL API (the Flutter app, the GraphQL explorer, third parties); the site proxies `/api` and `/api/` here. The schema is frozen and read-only: any mutation is rejected with `This API is read-only; use the REST API.` Responses carry `Deprecation: true`, a `Link` to these docs and, once a date is set, `Sunset`. Use the REST endpoints for anything new. Limits: depth 8, 250 fields, 15 aliases, a cost budget per request, `loos` pages of at most 100, `looNamesByIds` of at most 100 ids, `maxDistance` up to 50,000 m, 32 KiB request bodies.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: GraphQL query document (at most 10,000 characters).

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: JSON-encoded variables object.

200.description: A GraphQL response (`data` and/or `errors`). Validation and resolver errors also use 200, as the legacy API did.

400.description: Malformed request, or variables that do not match their types.

413.description: Query or request body too large.

429.description: Rate limited (shared with the other public reads).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma separated IDs (?ids=a,b) or repeat the parameter (?ids=a&ids=b). Duplicates are ignored; at most 100 distinct ids, each 24 characters.

post.description: Signed-in callers create the loo directly (201) unless they are blocked in Auth0. Anonymous and blocked callers have the new loo queued for moderation (202), as does anyone whose block status cannot be confirmed. Only admins may send `id`, `active`, `removalReason` or `location: null`, or place a loo outside the GB / NI / Isle of Man / Channel Islands box; anyone else gets 400 with an `error` code (`id_not_allowed`, `admin_only_fields`, `location_required`, `location_out_of_area`).

requestBody.description: Attributes to set for the new loo.

201.description: Loo created. Includes its `compressed` map tuple.

400.description: Invalid request payload, or a field or location only an admin may set (`error` names the rule).

401.description: Authentication required (Bearer token or session cookie).

409.description: A loo with the supplied ID already exists.

503.description: Editing is paused: the write kill switch is `read-only`, for every caller including admins. `error` is `read_only`; retry after the `Retry-After` header (seconds).

get.description: Map changes since a sync cursor: loos created or updated (`upserted`) and loos that left the map (`deleted`). Pass the `cursor` from `/api/loos/dump` or the previous `/updates` response as `since`, and store the new `cursor` for next time. Never cached.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: A `cursor` returned by `/api/loos/dump` or `/api/loos/updates` (ISO 8601). Do not send the client clock.

200.description: Incremental updates and the next cursor.

get.description: Revalidated on every use: send the previous `ETag` as `If-None-Match` to get a 304 while the loo is unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24 character loo identifier.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: An ETag from an earlier response. A match returns 304 with no body.

ETag.description: Weak per-record version: `W/"loo-<id>-<updatedAt epoch ms>-<body hash>"`. Also changes when joined data such as the area name does.

304.description: Not modified: the `If-None-Match` ETag is current.

put.summary: Update a loo (admins: or create it)
put.description: Signed-in callers write directly unless they are blocked in Auth0. Only admins may create a loo with PUT (an unknown id is a 404 for everyone else), send `active`, `removalReason` or `location: null` (400 `admin_only_fields` / `location_required`; use `/report` and `/restore`), or move a loo outside the GB / NI / Isle of Man / Channel Islands box (400 `location_out_of_area`). A non-admin move of more than 50 m is queued even for a trusted caller (202, `reason: large_move`). Anonymous and blocked callers (and anyone whose block status cannot be confirmed) can only suggest changes to existing loos: the changed fields are queued for moderation (202). Only fields that differ from the stored record are applied or queued. Reactivating a removed loo also clears its `removalCategory` and `duplicateOf`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24 character loo identifier.

200.description: Existing loo updated, or returned unchanged when nothing differed; both include the `compressed` map tuple. Anonymous or blocked callers' no-op submissions return `{ queued: false, unchanged: true }`.

201.description: New loo created (admins only). Includes its `compressed` map tuple.

202.description: Change queued for moderation (anonymous, blocked in Auth0, block status could not be confirmed, a non-admin move of more than 50 m, a move past the account's daily cap, or queue mode); see `reason`.

400.description: Invalid identifier or payload, or a field or location only an admin may set (`error` names the rule).

401.description: Authentication required (Bearer token or session cookie).

404.description: No loo has this id (only admins create with PUT).

503.description: Editing is paused: the write kill switch is `read-only`, for every caller including admins. `error` is `read_only`; retry after the `Retry-After` header (seconds).

post.summary: Report a problem (remove a loo from the map)
post.description: Signed-in callers who are not blocked in Auth0 remove the loo immediately: `active=false`, `removalCategory=reason`, `removalReason=details` (or a default sentence) and, for duplicates, `duplicateOf`. Everyone else queues a `remove` change for moderation, limited to one queued change a minute per caller. A non-admin account that has already made its daily allowance of removals and moves (default 10 in any 24 hours) is queued too (202, `reason: daily_cap`), and while the write kill switch is in queue mode every non-admin report is (`reason: queue_mode`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24 character loo identifier.

200.description: Removed. `compressed` is null: drop the loo from any cached map.

400.description: Invalid body: unknown reason, missing details for `other`, or a missing/invalid `duplicateOf` (unknown, removed, or this loo).

503.description: Editing is paused: the write kill switch is `read-only`, for every caller including admins. `error` is `read_only`; retry after the `Retry-After` header (seconds).

post.description: Signed-in callers who are not blocked in Auth0 put the loo back on the map and clear its removal category, reason and duplicate link (kept in the audit history). Everyone else queues a `restore` change. The body is optional.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24 character loo identifier.

200.description: Restored, with its `compressed` map tuple. `detailsIgnored: true` when `details` was sent: direct restores do not store it.

503.description: Editing is paused: the write kill switch is `read-only`, for every caller including admins. `error` is `read_only`; retry after the `Retry-After` header (seconds).

post.summary: Confirm a loo is still there
post.description: Anyone may verify. Anonymous callers, and signed-in callers who are blocked or whose block status cannot be confirmed, share the 1/min queued-write limit. Sets `verifiedAt` to now and changes nothing else (`updatedAt` is unchanged). No request body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24 character loo identifier.

409.description: `removed`: the loo is not on the map.

503.description: Editing is paused: the write kill switch is `read-only`, for every caller including admins. `error` is `read_only`; retry after the `Retry-After` header (seconds).

get.description: Contributor identifiers are redacted unless the caller includes an Auth0 admin bearer token.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 24 character loo identifier.

parameters.name: hydrate
parameters.description: Set to true to include full report snapshots instead of diffs.

200.description: Reports associated with the loo. Returns diffs by default; full records when hydrate=true.

401.description: Invalid authentication (Bearer token or session cookie). This endpoint is otherwise public.

get.description: Every active loo with a location, as compressed `[id, geohash, filterMask]` tuples (or full records with `rich=true`), plus a sync `cursor` for `/api/loos/updates`. Browsers may cache it for 60s and revalidate in the background for 300s more; edits made meanwhile arrive through `/updates`. The ETag is a dataset version, so `If-None-Match` revalidation is cheap.

parameters.name: rich
parameters.description: Return full loo details instead of compressed tuples. WARNING: Large response size. Has its own ETag (`W/"dump-rich-..."`).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: An ETag from an earlier response. A match returns 304 with no body.

200.description: All active loos (compressed or full) and a sync cursor.

ETag.description: Weak dataset version: `W/"dump-<max updated_at epoch ms>-<row count>-<sum of updated_at epoch µs>"`. Changes on every write, including out-of-order commits.

304.description: Not modified: the dataset has not changed since the `If-None-Match` ETag. Keep the cached body and its cursor.

parameters.name: geohash
parameters.description: Geohash prefix to match: 4-12 geohash (base32) characters, case-insensitive. Prefixes of exactly 4 characters take the stricter heavy-read rate limit.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter loos by activity status. Use `any` to disable the filter.

parameters.name: compressed
parameters.description: Return compressed data optimized for map rendering. If true, returns CompressedLoo objects.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Return summary data (more detailed than compressed, less than full). If true, returns Loo objects.

200.description: Loos matching the supplied geohash prefix.

parameters.description: Latitude in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in meters (default 1000).

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Also return removed (inactive) loos, flagged `active: false`. Default: active loos only.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: A loo id to leave out (e.g. the loo being edited).

200.description: Loos ordered by distance (nearest first). Cached for 60 seconds.
